lines.speaker: sehaj
lines.text: Vajjj. Those stock interns are walking backwards to optimize synergy.

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Their smiles are fighting sixty-mile-an-hour head-winds! CUT! Freeze the blades!

lines.speaker: sehaj
lines.text: Freeze the fan, then I'll hit Ctrl+Z on the broken catwalk. Move fast.
